question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **details**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Details **mean specific pieces of information or facts that provide a comprehensive understanding or description of a subject. (**विवरण**)

 
 
• **Example**: *In the report, the detective meticulously recorded all the details of the crime scene.*
 
 
 
• The word "**details**" is appropriate here because it refers to specific pieces of information or particulars that provide a thorough and comprehensive understanding of conclusions, decisions, and assignments.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Titles: **Distinctive names or designations given to a book, movie, article, or other works of art or literature. (**शीर्षक**)
 
• **Failures: **Instances or situations where goals are not achieved, expectations are not met, or endeavours do not succeed. (**असफलता**)
 
• **Short Cuts: **Quick or direct routes or methods that bypass traditional or longer processes, often aiming for more efficient or faster results. (**छोटा मार्ग**)
